summary: Iteration 32: tested the new Client & Revenue features. Backend pytest: 30/30 pass (10 new tests in test_crm_power.py plus the 20 regression tests in test_crm_revenue.py). In the UI, all 8 requested features pass. (1) Offline GSTIN on Clients Master: 27AAPFU0939F1ZV (typed lowercase, auto-uppercased) shows ✓, the label shows 'GST NUMBER · FIRM / LLP', PAN is set to AAPFU0939F and State to Maharashtra. 27AAPFU0939F1ZX shows ✗ with no auto-fill. (2) Client IFSC: SBIN0001234 and HDFC0000001 show ✓, and bankName/branchName/bankAddress/bankCity/bankState are filled and read-only. (3) /vendor field-gstNo: 29AAGCB7383J1Z4 shows ✓ with 'Company', and sets field-panNo AAGCB7383J and field-state Karnataka; an invalid checksum shows ✗. (4) Contracts contract-wo-type: Supply gives TDS 0 / Ret 0, Service 2/5, Composite 2/5. contract-compliance shows the label and 4 notes per type. woType persists after save, and the Type column shows 'Supply + Service (Composite)'. (5) The RA bill generated from MB takes the contract's tdsPct (manually set to 1) and retention 5%. Totals: basic 500, GST 90, retention 25, TDS 5, net 560. (6) ra-btn-delete stays enabled at step 3 and step 4. The confirm text includes the approved-bill warning. After deletion the MB entry can be billed again (raBillId cleared). For a milestone bill approved at step 3 then deleted, the milestone goes back to Pending (ms-complete button shows again). (7) Home sidebar order is gm then client_revenue, for both SuperAdmin and a User-role user. (8) Non-admin user (User role with approve=true perm): Edit, New and Submit are enabled; Approve and Delete are disabled; the contract row delete button is hidden; Edit then Save works. Backend _crm_power: GM-role and User-role users with approve perm get 403 on DELETE lead, on MB step 2→3, and on retention_releases. Admin role and SuperAdmin are allowed.

issues: The 'GSTIN valid' toast shows twice (top-center and top-right). VendorRegistration mounts its own <Toaster position='top-center'> and a global Toaster also exists. This duplicate-Toaster pattern is in many pages and was not introduced in this change.

action_items: Optional: remove the per-page <Toaster> in VendorRegistration.jsx (and other pages) if a global Toaster exists, to avoid duplicate toasts.

Optional: in RABills del(), MB entries are unmarked and the milestone reset BEFORE crmDelete. If the delete fails, the bill remains but its MBs/milestone are already detached. Delete first, then unmark (or do it server-side).
critical_code_review_comments: gstin.js checksum verified with node: valid 27AAPFU0939F1ZV, 29AAGCB7383J1Z4, 09AAACH7409R1ZZ; invalid 27AAPFU0939F1ZX. Lowercase input is rejected by parseGstin, but the input uppercases on change, so this is fine.

useGstin / Vendor GST effect fills PAN/State only when they are empty. If the user later changes the GSTIN to a different state, the old State/PAN stay. Consider overwriting when the previous value came from an earlier GSTIN autofill.
useGstin fires a success toast on every Load of a saved client that has a valid GSTIN (effect deps include f.gst). This is minor noise.

Frontend approve/delete gates (canDelete, role-based Admin/SuperAdmin) match backend _crm_power. A user's per-user approve=true permission does NOT grant CRM approval, which is consistent on both sides.
Edit is only enabled while step < 3 (Clients/RA/MB). This is by design: approved records are locked.
